newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-CARECA SCORES FIRST GOAL AS SANTOS QUALIFY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CARECA SCORES FIRST GOAL AS SANTOS QUALIFY.

text.p: Veteran striker Careca scored his first goal for Santos as they beat Portuguesa Santista 5-0 at the weekend to grab the final place in the play- off stage of the Sao Paulo championship.

The 36-year-old, who played for Brazil in the 1986 and 1990 World Cups, is still not fully match fit and has made only a few fleeting appearances as a substitute since joining the club in April as a free agent.
Santos had needed only a draw to finish second in group one and make sure of their place in the four-team final stage.

Their task was made easier when Portuguesa Santista, who do not have a competition to take part in until next year's Sao Paulo championship starts in February, had already begun disbanding their team during the week.
Ten players were released to play for clubs in other championships around the country, which still have one or two months to run.

A club spokesman said the team had been due to take part in division three of the national championship in the second half of the year but declined because of the high costs and low revenue generated.
Most of the squad members who took part in the current campaign had been playing on loan, he said.
Palmeiras, who beat Mogi Mirim 5-0, had already qualified on Thursday from group one while Corinthians and Sao Paulo had already sewn up group two the weekend before.
Sao Paulo suffered their first defeat under Dario Pereyra when they lost 2-0 to Guarani.
Guarani are coached by Muricy Ramalho, the man who was sacked by Sao Paulo in April to make way for Pereyra.
Ramalho was given the job at Guarani, where he is the club's third coach this year, one day after leaving Sao Paulo.
Fluminense beat Flamengo 2-0 in the Rio de Janeiro championship to stay top of the third stage. The stage winners will meet Botafogo, who won the first and second stages, in the final.
However, if Botafogo, who beat Americano 1-0 away, win the third stage as well, they take the title automatically.
